items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We recorded him in two contexts at RCA. One was studio dates, with Jimmy Jones, his favorite arranger.

ctx.x: Joe, I felt, is the greatest male singer of all time, after Louis Armstrong. I always have to put Louis first, because he’s in a class by himself. He’s the daddy, like Billie Holiday. “I’m as close as I can get to Louis Armstrong,” she would say. Joe was the absolute professional all the way. It was a delight to record him.
